build_encoder_decoder_model: build a FairseqEncoderDecoderModel by passing an encoder and decoder instance to the constructor
load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained FairseqModel using from_pretrained with a model name or checkpoint path
extract_features_encoder_decoder: extract features from a FairseqEncoderDecoderModel by calling extract_features with source and target tokens
optimize_for_generation: optimize a BaseFairseqModel for faster generation by calling make_generation_fast_ to remove weight norms
build_multi_model: build a FairseqMultiModel by passing dicts of encoders and decoders with matching keys
